fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of bug change set 01M797T (no owner). The planner read run.go (checkAgentSteps refuses a queued start with no --permission-mode at queue time), queueRunStart (records the start's mode, possibly empty) and daemon.go's queued-start loop (fills an empty mode with rhiza.daemon.permissionMode). On this dedicated VM a dry-run with bypassPermissions passes the trust check; with no mode it is refused ('agent step with no permission mode'). The planner asked two questions (queue-time check, and the no-mode case); the arbiter answered both with Decision queued-run-daemon-mode: check at queue time with the daemon's setting standing in, queue with no mode so the daemon applies its setting at start; keep the refusal when the setting is unset or the start is --foreground, with the message naming rhiza.daemon.permissionMode. The change set serves m4-orchestrated-by-rhiza: the incident needed an orchestrator to kill processes by PID. Leaves are under run-start-through-daemon. Not breaking (only a refusal becomes a queue), not severe.
fields.title: Plan interview: a queued run takes the daemon's permission mode
